subject: Emergency readiness pack request & live walkthrough
messages:
From: Alyssa Kline <security@harmonypay.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: ops_lead@harmonypay.com
Date: 2026-09-19T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor resilience evidence request: BCP/DR artifacts and walkthrough

Ben––

Thanks for the quick turn here. For HarmonyPay's vendor resilience review we need a compact evidence set from Redwood covering business continuity and recent recovery exercises. Please provide or link the following:  

- concise BCP/DR runbook (failover paths, trigger thresholds, recovery steps)
- RTO/RPO commitments by service tier and the last 90-day measured samples (timestamps and short notes)
- a sample KV/warm-cache snapshot and the recovery trace (replay log) you use for warm-starts
- on-call/key-holder manifest + escalation matrix for a recovery window
- any tabletop/exercise summaries or recordings you can share

We'd also like a 45-minute live walkthrough with your operations team (demo the failover and talk through the playbook). Week of Sep 21 works — propose two slots and indicate which artifacts will be surfaced live.

If any of this is sensitive, links with access controls are fine.

—Alyssa
Security, HarmonyPay

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Kline <security@harmonypay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-19T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor resilience evidence request: BCP/DR artifacts and walkthrough

Hi Alyssa,

Appreciate the list — we can provide everything you asked for. Attached are links to the runbook and the latest tabletop summary. We're including an anonymized KV snapshot and the replay log as a sample; production keys removed.

Proposed walkthrough slots (all PDT):
- Tue Sep 22, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Sep 23, 15:00–15:45

Who from your side will join (security + ops ok)? For the live demo we'll show:
- a controlled failover from primary to warm-standby (short replay)
- validation checks and operator commands we run during recovery

Attachments: redwood_bcp_runbook_v2.pdf, tabletop_summary_20260722.mp4, kv_warm_snapshot_20260915.log

Thanks,
Ben Carter
